Name: Classic Mobile Phone Themes
Author: UltimateGamer10101
Description:
This is a content pack created for the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6523]Mobile Phone[/url] mod created by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/18901754]aedenthorn[/url]﻿.

Simply unzip and add the mod to your mods folder, and the next time you launch the game and use the Mobile Phone, these skins and backgrounds will be available for selection in the Customization app on the phone.

As has been brought to my attention, there is the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/21017]Mobile Phone Continued[/url] mod that this also works with.﻿ A separate file for this mod has been uploaded with the manifest file edited to support it.

Downloads.Description: Reuploaded as a zip file; hopefully now it'll be downloaded as a zip file.

Manifest.Name: Classic Mobile Phone Themes
Manifest.Description: Adds skins and backgrounds with a more classic SDV appearance to the mobile phone.
Manifest.Author: UltimateGamer10101

Downloads.Description: For those of you who want to use these themes with Mobile Phone Continued by JoXW, without having to edit the manifest file.
